items.task: Create a real-life situation that uses Indian place value system up to ten-thousands and beyond. Record the quantities and explain your reasoning.
Find one example at home/school of reading and writing large numbers. Draw or photograph the representation and label it.
Design a pair activity for comparing and ordering numbers. Each partner must explain the answer in a different way.
Collect two measurements or observations connected to number patterns and digit swaps and compare them.
Make a small poster teaching rounding to nearest tens, hundreds and thousands to a younger learner. Include one worked example.
Invent a challenge based on distance, time and travel calculations; exchange it with a classmate and check the solution.
